en-US.longDescription: ACA 1095 Reporting MultiClient version is 1094/1095 reporting and e-filing software that can be used to file multiple FEINs. It is designed for self-insured and other businesses that must file forms 1095-C or 1095-B for health care coverage for their employees and accompanying transmittals (1094-C or 1094-B). This is a multi client, site license version.
en-US.name: ACA 1095 Reporting MultiClient

zh-CN.description: ACA 1094/1095 申报与电子报送软件
zh-CN.longDescription: ACA 1095 Reporting MultiClient 版本面向多个 FEIN 的 1094/1095 申报与电子报送，专为必须为员工提交 1095-C 或 1095-B 医疗保险承保表及相应 1094-C 或 1094-B 传送表的自保企业和其他企业设计。本版本为多客户端站点授权版本。
